Big Shark West Saturday Gravel Growl

Chesterfield, MO · Gravel

No-drop

Big Shark West Saturday Gravel Growl is a gravel group ride in Chesterfield, MO. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Big Shark West (next to Kaldi's Coffee). About 27 miles, no-drop within the posted pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop within the posted pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bigsharkbicycleco the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Big Shark West Saturday Gravel Growl group ride

A 27-mile gravel loop on the Monarch Levee Trail, the Katy Trail, Busch Greenway and the Hamburg Trail, starting and ending at the west county store. Runs all winter. Gravel, cross, mountain or hybrid bike.
